blocks.text: Conjugated molecules mukhtalif qismon (categories) se taalluq rakhne wale do ya zyada molecules ke milne se bante hain. Kuch aham conjugated molecules glycoproteins, glycolipids, lipoproteins aur nucleoproteins hain.

blocks.title: Conjugated molecule
blocks.text: Biomolecule ki mukhtalif qismon ke do ya zyada molecules mila kar bana molecule, maslan protein ke saath carbohydrate, lipid ke saath carbohydrate, lipid ke saath protein, ya nucleic acid ke saath protein.

Glycoproteins ek protein aur ek carbohydrate polymer ke darmiyan covalent jor se bante hain. Yeh qudrat mein bohat aam hain: membranes ke lazmi banawati (structural) ajza ke taur par, khoon ke serum mein, cell ke ifrazat (secretions) ke taur par, aur cartilage, aankhon, jild aur doosre tissues mein.
Glycolipids ek lipid aur ek carbohydrate ke darmiyan covalent jor se bante hain. Yeh membranes ka lazmi banawati juz hain.

Lipoproteins biomolecules ki woh class hain jo lipids aur proteins ke darmiyan hydrophobic taalluqat (interactions) se banti hai, covalent ya ionic bonds se nahin. Lipoproteins har qisam ki plasma membrane ka bunyadi banawati dhancha (framework) hain. Lipids khoon mein very low-density lipoproteins ki shakal mein le jaye jate hain.

Nucleoproteins chromosome ke DNA aur proteins ke darmiyan ionic bonds se bante hain. Maslan DNA se jure histone proteins nucleosomes banate hain. Yeh eukaryotes mein chromosome ki banawat ko mustahkam (stabilise) karte hain aur gene expression ke qaboo mein bhi aham kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.caption: Aam conjugated molecules
rows: Membranes (banawati), khoon ka serum, cell ke ifrazat, cartilage, aankhen, jild
Tamam plasma membranes ka dhancha; khoon mein very low-density lipoproteins ke taur par lipid transport

blocks.prompt: Kaun se conjugated molecules covalent bonds ke baghair jure hain, aur kis qisam ki kashish se? Kaun sa plasma membrane ka dhancha hai?
blocks.explanation: Lipoproteins hydrophobic taalluqat se aur nucleoproteins ionic bonds se jure hain; dono covalent bonds istemal nahin karte. Lipoproteins plasma membranes ka bunyadi banawati dhancha hain, aur glycoproteins aur glycolipids lazmi ajza.

items: Conjugated molecules mukhtalif qismon ke molecules ko milate hain.

Glycoproteins (protein + carbohydrate, covalent) aur glycolipids (lipid + carbohydrate, covalent) membranes ke banawati hisse hain; glycoproteins serum, ifrazat, cartilage, aankhon aur jild mein bhi hote hain.

Lipoproteins (lipid + protein, hydrophobic taalluqat) plasma membranes ka dhancha hain aur khoon mein very low-density lipoproteins ke taur par lipids le jate hain; nucleoproteins (DNA + histones, ionic) nucleosomes banate, chromosomes mustahkam karte aur gene expression qaboo karte hain.
